task: Validate the 131-job parallel regression runner with distinct development and optimized compiler paths.
observation: The first full parallel run failed before Moss assertions in tests that derive Margo from the compiler's sibling path and in an SDK runner that overrides MOSS with its checkout's root/moss. The original job invocation passed build/compiler/moss-dev or moss-opt directly, while isolated worktrees contained no root/moss executable.
impact: Package tests reported missing executable paths even though both compiler variants had been built, so the initial full-suite result could not be interpreted as Moss regressions.
evidence: make --jobs="$(nproc)" check TEST_JOBS=8 on phase25-parallel-tests at 1dc0a6d

resolution.summary: The intake runner places a job-local moss launcher beside margo in every isolated worktree, routes MOSS and direct test arguments through it, and requires the selected optimized compiler to exist. Focused ABI migration and text encoding SDK jobs now pass.

task: Run the advanced-data compiled-only provider acceptance step concurrently with other regression jobs.
observation: The provider scheduler's DAG permitted two independent parent Margo builds to overlap after their common core provider completed. Margo rebuilds each package's full dependency closure, so those parents simultaneously wrote sdk/foundations/core/build/debug/libcore.rlib; rustc failed to open an object file while creating the archive.
impact: The full 16-worker suite failed sdk_adv_data_source_free after 51.37 seconds despite disjoint outer job worktrees. The nested failure was initially hidden by capture_output and became actionable after retaining its stdout/stderr tail.
evidence: make --jobs="$(nproc)" check TEST_JOBS=16: sdk_adv_data_source_free FAIL in 51.37s
margo: build_graph rebuilds each package in its resolved graph
python3 tests/run_parallel.py --jobs 1 --filter sdk_adv_data_source_free: PASS in 267.10s after package-closure locking

resolution.summary: Provider builds now acquire locks for every package in the complete dependency closure in stable order and use per-provider Margo homes. Disjoint closures still overlap; the isolated source-free acceptance rerun passes.
